title: 不用被动的情况

examples.en: This kind of book sells well.

guess.question: “事故发生”为什么不能说成 The accident was happened？

options.text: 因为 happen 是不及物动词，后面接不了宾语，也就没有被动
options.feedback: 对！没有宾语的动词变不了被动，这是第一条。
不对——能不能用被动跟好事坏事无关。

options.text: 因为 happened 已经是过去式了
options.feedback: 不对——过去式照样能变被动，如 was broken。

rule.rule: 不及物动词、系动词、belong to 等没有被动；另有一类动词用主动形式表示被动含义
rule.formula: ① 无被动：happen / take place / come true / belong to / appear / disappear　② 系动词 + 形容词：The flower smells sweet.　③ 主动表被动：The book sells well. / The pen writes smoothly.

anchors.en: This kind of book sells well.

trap.why: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住三不用：发生类（happen/take place）、感官系动词（look/sound/taste）、所属类（belong to）。

check.stem: 把 “The meeting took place yesterday.” 判断一下，哪句写法正确？

options.text: The meeting was taken place yesterday.
The meeting was took place yesterday.
The meeting took place by them yesterday.

check.explanation: take place（发生、举行）没有被动语态。

options.distractor: 这是描述特性，用现在时

check.explanation: “这笔写起来很流畅”用主动形式 writes smoothly。

options.distractor: 正确：系动词 + 形容词

options.text: The accident was happened last night.

options.distractor: 正确：系动词 + 形容词

check.explanation: happen 没有被动，应改为 The accident happened last night。
